description: Calendar date of the daily record
Generic (INN) name of the active ingredient
High / Medium / Low demand class of the medicine
True demand of the day (sales + unserved requests)
Festival / public holiday (footfall dip); known in advance

how_it_is_calculated: days with demand > rolling_mean_30 + 2.5 x rolling_std_30 (stats from earlier days) and demand >= 3

description: On-hand stock at start of day
Units received from the supplier that day
how_it_is_calculated: Orders placed earlier that arrive today (lead time + delays)
Mostly when stock far exceeds 60 days of demand

description: On-hand stock at end of day (never negative)
how_it_is_calculated: opening + purchase + return + adjustment - quantity_sold - damaged - expired

description: Stock on hand at prediction time (end of day)
Units held for pending pre-bookings / counters

how_it_is_calculated: ceil(planning demand x lead time + safety_stock)
ceil(z x demand std x sqrt(lead time)), z varies by medicine

description: Ordered but not yet delivered (open purchase orders)
how_it_is_calculated: Sum of open orders at end of day

description: Quoted delivery time of the latest received order
how_it_is_calculated: Supplier lead time (+1 for Saturday orders)

description: Actual delivery time of the latest received order
how_it_is_calculated: Lead time + jitter + delay events (more delays for low reliability)

description: Days since the last delivery was received
how_it_is_calculated: t - day of last receipt (0 on delivery day)

description: Model-like baseline forecast of daily demand (info up to day t only)
how_it_is_calculated: (0.5xMA7 + 0.3xMA14 + 0.2xMA30) x weekday factor x seasonal factor x (1+0.25xtrend) x medicine bias x noise(9%); floor 0.05

description: Days the available stock will last
Expected demand during supplier lead time
Stock needed to cover lead time safely
Share of stock-out days in previous 90 days

how_it_is_calculated: Weighted shortfall vs required_stock, coverage vs lead time, variability, trend, lead time, reliability, spikes, past stock-outs, reorder level, open orders, + noise (+22 if stock-out occurred)
If replenishment_required: ceil(max(0, required_stock - available_stock - on_order_quantity) / MOQ) x MOQ else 0

example: Open purchase order covers projected requirement
how_it_is_calculated: Priority rules: stock-out > below safety stock > rising trend > long lead time > below reorder level > below requirement > open PO / sufficient / overstock
